title: Mystic Night Wanderer
description: A surreal black and white line drawing on black paper features a large central female figure with three cat-like masks, her torso containing five stylized eyes with purple, blue, and pink details. To the right, a crystal ball on a stand displays multiple eyes and text reading 'THE EYE OF THE BEHOLDER'. A small hiker with backpack and staff stands at the bottom right, looking up at the scene. A large red celestial body with constellation lines floats in the starry sky above a purple lavender field.
prompt: surreal black and white line drawing with selective color on black paper, large central female figure with three cat masks and torso filled with five stylized eyes in purple blue and pink, crystal ball on stand with multiple eyes and text 'THE EYE OF THE BEHOLDER', small hiker with backpack and staff looking up, large red celestial body with constellations in starry sky, purple lavender field in background, mystical and occult symbols, chalk pastel texture
medium: chalk or pastel on black paper
